profile.headline: Full Stack Web Developer
profile.summary: Experienced software engineer adept in problem-solving and solution-oriented approaches. Proficient in developing and managing applications across diverse industries, with a track record of delivering high-quality software. Effective communicator, skilled at building strong relationships with clients, team members, and subcontractors. Additionally, I have experience with Scrum methodology, contributing to efficient project management and collaboration.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
o	Developed a minimalist personal website for Hilary Watts, focusing on her educational and professional background with an emphasis on research skills.
Incorporated minimal animations using Framer to enhance user interest.

o	Developed a personal website for Hilary Watts to showcase her skills, including a portfolio, work history, testimonials, and details about her specialty.
Created a visually appealing and fully responsive website to effectively highlight her expertise and experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
o	Led development of client interface using React Native for the Web, facilitating creation of medical supply label sets.
o	Integrated frontend with Django backend
o	Supervised a team of 4 developers, ensuring cohesive collaboration and project progress.
positions.insights: React Native Web, JavaScript and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States · Remote
positions.description:
o	Contributed to development of Django application for processing ASIN data and generating Amazon trend reports.
o	Visualized data using Matplotlib and built a website to display reports using Django CMS.
o	Fostered client relationships, collected feedback, and resolved issues.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
o	Utilized agile project management principles, specifically employing the Scrum methodology to conduct daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and sprint retrospectives.
o	Cultivated strong client relationships by actively seeking feedback, transforming ideas into features through collaborative workshops, and promptly addressing any arising issues. 

DIGINDIRT (Verisage client) -
o	Engineered the EQT mobile application to facilitate inventory management and maintenance of heavy machinery for the client.
o	Crafted the DND mobile application to enhance efficiency in excavators' dirt-finding and transportation processes
o	Designed and developed the HND mobile application, aiding excavators in client and trucking assignment management..
o	Contributed to the UX/UI design process by outlining user experiences on whiteboards.
Implemented agile methodology to effectively segment the workflow into manageable tasks.
o	Successfully deployed applications to both Apple's App Store and the Google Play Store.
